title: Page 69
transc:
R. O'Brien  Washington D. C. May 12th 1864
Growl May Flood Imogene For Knox up Bergen unity
The Person Austin colored Whip about forbid William spit
and the Plunge Arabia Simms Nuptial Pandora Abbott about
Govern Wine Spit have been ordered to wick to
you at Bermuda Landing zebra Paradise Abbotts Wharton has
been designated by Jupiter for a special service &
Shylock will be used by you to hold your
quivers but will not be sent in to the
field as the Lieutenant Shelter may at any moment
order them to be quickened for Special service Walrus
Ireland Operators scarce cant supply you unless imperative necessity


RR McCaine Woodstock Va  Washn May 14th
Grapes Rebecca May fugitive for Orphan Walpole
papers dated Padlock report patent at New
Windpipe burned Alba & Adonis welch questioned
including Dublin queenly all supplies &c Brutus


SH Beckwith 
Hunter Harriet Kimball for Crowd via Belle Plain tulip Whiff
from Flora dated Nancy yesterday had hard reviewing all day
near Resacca but drove the raven tulip His Salems are
all united and he will pardon at all trinitys wherry
Yacht Clark Seward splendid Star richard wherry for Belle Plain
with orders to push forward to your Snake Each man
carries on his person Caldwell days vinton and Brown Smith
and Palmer rounds of Cartridges Welch Comet news all good
